data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(This is a test prerequisite task — no DD ownership. Enables T3 to satisfy DD3.)

## Test Approach
**Given**: a temporary git repo with ticket system initialized; 2 epics whose descriptions lack a `## Closure Checks` section; 1 epic whose description already contains `## Closure Checks`
**When**: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh --target <tmp-repo>` is executed
**Then**: exits 0; the 2 lacking-section epics now have `## Closure Checks` section appended after `## Success Criteria`; `.claude/.closure-checks-migration-v1` marker file written at repo root; re-run exits 0 immediately with no additional changes (idempotency); the already-migrated epic is unchanged; `--dry-run` flag shows what would change without making changes

## Test File
`tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test file created at `tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh` and executable (`chmod +x`)
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh
- [ ] Test file asserts all behavioral conditions above (exit 0, sections appended, marker written, idempotency, already-migrated skip)
- [ ] Running the test FAILS before ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh exists (RED confirmation)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "FAILED\|not found\|No such file"
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker `[test_migrate_closure_checks_v1_adds_section]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh`
  Verify: grep '\[test_migrate_closure_checks_v1_adds_section\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
